description: Shift left: rule exports to coding-agent instruction files and their drift (spec §10.2, PRD FR-S6).

panels.description: Repos with at least one exported instruction file.
panels.title: Repos exporting

panels.description: Repos whose every exported file matches the latest rendering.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Current" FROM export_drift WHERE versions_behind = 0

panels.title: Current

panels.description: Repos whose exports are more than two exported config versions behind (spec §10.2); they also appear in the platform digest.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Behind" FROM export_drift WHERE versions_behind > 2

panels.title: More than two versions behind

panels.description: Generated blocks someone edited by hand; the export job leaves them until resolved.
panels.title: Hand-edited files

panels.description: Per repo: versions behind (config versions exported since its furthest-behind file last matched), files, open proposals, hand edits, and the open export PR.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT repo AS "Repo", versions_behind AS "Versions behind", files AS "Files", proposed AS "Proposed", edited AS "Edited",
  round(extract(epoch FROM now() - oldest_change) / 86400.0, 1) AS "Oldest change (days)", pr_url AS "Export PR"
FROM export_drift ORDER BY versions_behind DESC, repo

panels.title: Export drift by repo

panels.description: Exported files per target (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Copilot, Cursor) and state.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT target AS "Target", count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'current') AS "Current", count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'proposed') AS "Proposed",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'edited') AS "Edited", count(*) FILTER (WHERE auto_merged) AS "Auto-merge set"
FROM exports GROUP BY target ORDER BY target

panels.title: Files by target and state

panels.description: Config versions the export job has rendered, per week.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', first_seen) AS "time", count(*) AS "Versions"
FROM export_runs WHERE $__timeFilter(first_seen) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Config versions exported

panels.description: Per exported rule (spec §10.4): violations per in-scope PR when the PR's coding agent read the rule's export, against the rest, and in exporting repos before and after the export landed. The digest asks the owner to rewrite a summary when no measurable comparison drops by 20%.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT rule_id AS "Rule",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE received) AS "Agent read it (PRs)",
  round(avg(violations) FILTER (WHERE received), 2) AS "Violations/PR",
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT received) AS "Others (PRs)",
  round(avg(violations) FILTER (WHERE NOT received), 2) AS "Others violations/PR",
  round(avg(violations) FILTER (WHERE export_landed > first_review), 2) AS "Before landing",
  round(avg(violations) FILTER (WHERE export_landed <= first_review), 2) AS "After landing"
FROM upstream_pr_rule WHERE $__timeFilter(first_review)
GROUP BY rule_id ORDER BY rule_id
